notes.title: Version 2.0 Preview – Smarter AI, Better Combat, and New Gameplay
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! The work is continuing on version 2.0, which represents a massive update to the game with improvements everywhere — from enemy AI to combat itself — with new tools for players to tackle enemies, improved crafting, and a lot of old bugs finally being squashed.[/p][p]It's been a very heavy month in terms of workload, and I'm off for a week on holiday, so work on the 2.0 update will resume in September. In the meantime, I'd like to share a sneak preview of what you can expect to see in Cacildes Adventure 2.0.[/p][p]Overall — better combat, better UI, smarter AI, and NPCs that go about their lives. There will be new items, spells, and armor that are shared across both player and AI, making everything truly data-driven. You’ll also see new dialogue with more options as a result of converting all conversations to a text-based solution with INK, which allows for a smoother writing experience for me (writing dialogue in the Unity Editor is a pain).[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the sneak peak![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BRA1k9dSvEQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You will also notice in the video that the gold bug has been squashed! This was a very old exploit that allowed players to die and pick up gold from chests again. This happened because the save system would reload the entire save file, which reset the pickups, but the lost gold was not taken into account. Now, on death, you are only respawned in the location, without the world resetting.[/p][p]But enough words — here’s a video with 30 minutes of gameplay, along with some screenshots. I hope you enjoy :-)[/p][p][/p][p]And for newcomers — version 2.0 brings improvements to the base game, but the current version is definitely stable and ready to be enjoyed as well![/p][p][/p][p]I hope to see you all soon. Thank you for playing Cacildes Adventure and for your support! ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/25fe3dbdf425be2513dc86a5dbc95e503fff9619.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/57d1a79732ae55c444cb8f7ec32f4c533419b09f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/81281baf28e3ff955d6e38a27c6ba4b4f290e0fc.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/f2ec0e7675ccbfc1bff016c9ec46bc7bde9c21a1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/98d2cf8419bcc82b79c21e59c6f4404bd9c2ee8a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/16fd738a78772cf11589abe5f91dc8942cceaa29.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ☀️ Summer Update - Better enemies, spell overhaul and improved crafting...
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! 😊
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/2dc6cc6037017c6f0818911de6b8da2913693566.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s finally summer here in Portugal, and with a bit more daylight available, I’ve had more time to continue working on improvements for the game![/p][p]With version 1.7 bringing story updates and 1.8 (launched last month) introducing dual-wielding and better combat, it’s now time to take a few months to “clean house” — refactoring a ton of code and preparing the game for something much bigger.[/p][p]Let’s talk about what’s happening behind the scenes, and what you can expect from version 1.9 (or maybe even 2.0… this next update is shaping up to be massive!).[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]✅ What’s Already Done:[/h2][p][/p][h3]🔮 Ability System Overhaul — Spells No Longer Require Staves[/h3][p]The consumable card system has been replaced with a cleaner ability system that simplifies spellcasting. From the next update onwards:[/p][list][*][p]Spells no longer require staves to cast.[/p][/*][*][p]Use the Q key or Triangle on your controller to cast instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]You can cast spells even without the required Intelligence stat — they’ll just do less damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Spells can now be charged by holding the key/button, increasing the final damage![/p][/*][/list][p]Here's a look in action:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BhHmDoKcKZI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="jAuv2CRoWHc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This system also allows combat abilities to be equipped into the spell slot. For example:
Throw Weapon is vastly improved and benefits from charging — the longer you hold, the harder it hits![/p][previewyoutube="NgGsKBrWaJE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And here's a bonus one: Setting up traps using the portal spell to make quick work of enemies![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="aujPnxzT4II;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 What’s in Progress:[/h2][p][/p][h3]🧠 Smarter Enemies & Shared Combat Logic[/h3][p][/p][p]Enemies are getting a major upgrade! They’ll soon use the exact same systems as the player:[/p][list][*][p]Dual-wielding and combo logic[/p][/*][*][p]Switching weapons mid-fight[/p][/*][*][p]Custom attack styles depending on equipped weapons[/p][/*][/list][p]An enemy might start with a spear and shield, and mid-battle switch to dual greatswords. The sky’s the limit!
[/p][previewyoutube="rQtctbljOLQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Best of all, this refactor centralizes logic, which means fewer bugs and easier item creation in future.[/p][p]And yes — if you see an enemy with a cool weapon, it might now drop as loot![/p][p][/p][p]This opens the door for full companion customization (like Hugo), letting you equip different weapons and define their entire fighting style.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔨 Crafting System & Smithing Shards[/h3][p]Work is underway to expand the upgrade system beyond weapons:[/p][list][*][p]Armor and spells will be upgradable too[/p][/*][*][p]Iron Shards are being replaced with Smithing Shards[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons can be upgraded all the way to +10[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Coming Soon (Fixes & Plans):[/h2][list][*][p]Gold dupe bug will be fixed (caused by gold persisting after death/load)[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad icon bug — PS4 controller icons sometimes fail to load. This is being investigated.[/p][/*][*][p]New Armor Sets!
Currently testing edited 3D models from Synty to add fresh armors like the Samurai Set:
[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="M1tXyi6wX10;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]This huge rework is a great opportunity to revisit old maps and polish up existing content too. Tons of new weapons, spells, and abilities are on the way.
So stay tuned — there’s a lot more coming! 🚀[/p]

notes.title: [1.4.6] Bugfixes & Cloud Saving
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/bfae1083da27bcf1c40fa66cd1de3c5b18a672d3.png[/img]

Brief update this week! Here's the full log

[b]Additions[/b]

- Steam Cloud Save is now supported! Tested on my steam deck, seems to be working fine. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/e1196f380e05faff109308a2a4c13de01126ec80.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]

- Increase the damping on collision to reduce camera clipping when the player collides with walls, preventing the camera from passing through the environment as often.

- Lowered the damage from stone knights in Maerimond's cavern. Increased the delay between firing shots for one of the archers.

- Removed unrestricted quest progress in Veilglades expansion. It would cause quests to be out of order. Now the player needs to follow a specific path in order to complete the expansion.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Fixed wolves not attacking player when sleeping and getting shot from a distance with an arrow or a spell

- Added null pointer protection to damage during combat, for some reason it's not entirely reproducible so a few more logs were added to this so I can investigate further.

- Fixed miscellaneous issues with settings menu

- Fixed the null pointer error when clicking Continue, which appeared enabled even though there were no save files. What happened was that Steam Cloud created a file inside the save folder, and the game thought there were game files to load.

- Fixed some accessories giving too much buff on attack, specifically Herculean Ring and the Noble Lance and Noble Sword rings. There was an error in the calculation.

notes.title: [1.4.5] Release of The Veilglade Expansion
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/b4ab1fe694f4be661a497f677e2412a49f4fd7fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/5e4893a7efcb26a3384c508bcd5a17cf4bd1e073.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the Veilglades[/h1]

Exciting to announce that the second expansion of Cacilde's Adventure is finally out!

After Cacilde finds a mysterious shipmaster in Mountainpass, he is warned not to sail to the Veilglade Peninsula. So naturally, that's what he does...

Explore vampiric crypts, underwater universities and even a sky city! New weapons and gear await, with new swords, double swords, throwable javelins and even a hunting rifle. And best of all, it's free for owners of the base game!

So tag along! Hope you have a grand time exploring this new expansion. ːsteamhappyː

[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] New maps: Impossible City and Vella Tower
[*] New big sword: Impossible Sword
[*] New katana: Sanguine Blade
[*] New arrow type: Blood Soaked Arrow
[*] New lance: Golden Lance
[*] New armor set: Elite Knight Set
[*] New armor set: Silver Knight Set
[*] It is now possible to craft arrows using alchemy - recipes have been added for all types of arrows
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Cards are no longer displayed occupying the screen if a enemy is nearby and in active battle with player
[*] Improved Gorth boss fight in Obsidian Keep with new animations and lowered his health from 8000 to 7000
[*] Improved animation set for lance weapons: Lance and Partisan
[*] Reduced build size substantially by compressing textures of the project overall and also the videos from the tutorial section, the game size is back to 4gb - for reference, it was 12gb on the previous version! Auch... :)
[*] Now, when stamina drops below 25%, regeneration is significantly accelerated, and moderately increased when below 50%. This change makes combat more fluid, allowing the player to recover quickly after running out of stamina, reducing the wait time before the next attack.
[*] Some of the newer weapons can now feature more than 2 light attack animations, allowing up to 4 combo sequences. For heavy attacks, certain weapons now have 2 distinct heavy attacks instead of just one.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugfixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Vella was not giving bullets to player
[/list]

notes.title: [1.4.1] Bugfixes and UI Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/0a0f2f1308e01cd76573224338cb358baa90876d.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Busy week with tons of bug fixes and UI improvements. So here's the list!

[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]

- Added Changelog feature to title screen. It is now possible to see what changes have been made to the game over time

[previewyoutube=HY3A05ioo84;full][/previewyoutube]

- New Card: Windcutter
- New Card: Anvil Smash
- New Card: Wallclimber

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

- Enhanced lock-on targeting so that occlusion now focuses on the player rather than the enemy. This resolves the issue where the camera would zoom in on an enemy if they moved behind a rock or wall.

- Added support to return to title screen by pressing ESC on the following menus: Credits, Options, Load Game and Changelog

- Changed Weight Indicator in UI to be green for lighter equipments, and red for heavier ones

- Enemies no longer collide with player when they die. Previously, they could block doorways and lock player inside certain areas.

- Adjusted status effect logic so that when a player is inflicted, the applied amount equals the base resistance only, ignoring any resistance bonuses. Previously, equipping a resistance ring would cause the status effect bar to grow larger, making the negative effect last longer. Now, it applies only to the base amount, ensuring higher resistance has no drawbacks.

- Made status effect indicator of enemies larger, to better display what status are being applied during battle

- Made the negative status effects applied to the player more noticeable by adding a new HUD indicator. The indicator flashes on the screen once the bar is filled and the status effect activates.

[u][b]Bugfixes[/b][/u]

- Fixed the issue of lost gold appearing in inaccessible locations. Previously, the coins would respawn exactly at the player’s death position, which in some cases resulted in them spawning underwater. Now, the coins are placed at the last grounded position before the player's death, ensuring they respawn in an accessible location.

- Fixed Credits screen not appearing on Title Screen

- Made shop doors in Arun Village not collide with player. This is to avoid that players get locked inside shops if the store closes because of night time.

- Fixed poise displaying wrong values when hovering over equipment

- Fixed Martin dialogue not triggering after opening his cell in Mountainpass

- Fixed poison and blood resin not applying damage to enemies

- Fixed Hugo not attacking the bear due to the stopping distance being too low

That's it for this week! Enjoy this new update :-D

notes.title: [v1.4] The Cards Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New adventure trailer is here ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=Aze0u5ZipH0;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, major update this week with the addition of collectable cards!

This is a new mechanic that will allow you to perform new actions in combat - collect cards from enemies and use their abilities! The card are consumables that get replenished whenever you rest at a bonfire.

By far, one of the most interesting cards in the deck currently is the WEAPON TOSS, which allows you to throw any equipped weapon at any enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/e11df5a0888e0a6af2067cf0a76c3a1fd18bb539.gif[/img]

There's also a ton of bug fixes. Take a look:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Crystal Knight Celes' collision would remain active after the first battle.
[*] Fixed teleport issues with Midnight Omen.
[*] Added new attacks to the boss bear.
[*] Fixed teleport issue in Arun Garden when falling near the bee boss fight.
[*] Enemies will have increased posture resistance each time their posture is broken.
[*] Made it impossible to backstab continuously. There is now a cooldown before you can backstab an enemy again. The same applies to enemy poise—you won't be able to stagger them immediately after they've been staggered.
[*] Added a visual indicator to the HUD if you don't have enough stamina or mana.
[*] Increased the Lock-On Target Switching Threshold to reduce unintentional lock-on switches.
[*] Reduced critical damage values to balance difficulty.
[/list]

There's also the possibility to visit the Veilglade Pensinula, which will be the setting for the next expansion currently in the works. This map is a work in progress, though, so keep that in mind should you decide to visit it!

As always, thank you for your support :-D Enjoy this new update!

notes.title: [v1.3.4] + Bugfixes, Faith and Hex Spells now scale with reputation
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/9ba976886ae31374cd7f703db9a0adde58e9651d.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Quick update to kick off the week. I spent the weekend playing a Mage build on my Steam deck, and found some issues related to magic, so this update should fix them!

Here's what's changed:

Gameplay Improvements:
- Increased posture damage recovery rate - you will now be able to withstand more blows and your posture will decrease faster, allowing you to stay on your feet!
- Putting points in Dexterity will now increase jump height and movement speed at higher levels
- Posture scaled with strength. It now scales with Vitality too
- Removed Morning Star requirements to allow mage-build players to complete Roberto's quest

Combat Enhancements:
- Fixed issue where magic wasn't damaging certain enemies (dragons, bears, skull crabs, wolves, etc.)
- Lightning Strike spell damage now scales with Positive Reputation
- Dark spells now scale with Negative Reputation
- Buffed Wildfire Bomb: increased damage and duration
- Made Molok Blade a hex weapon
- Made Drake Sword a hex weapon
- Made Mace of Gilded Grip a faith weapon
- Made Golden Age Saber a faith weapon
- Made Twinblades a faith weapon

Bug Fixes:
- Resolved Flower Lady Lockon issue
- Fixed Sandworm Null Pointer errors related to a missing combat audio source

UI/UX:
- Added option to hide HUD (nice for screenshots!)

There's also been a significant price drop to the game. I believe it will be more inviting for new players as I'm preparing the next big expansion to the game.

As always, expect more updates soon.
Stay tuned! :)

notes.title: [v1.3.3] The Magic Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

This week update is focused on the mage build as there's two new staves available.

I won't spoil their location, but each offers cool reasons to wield them. One imbues poison with every spell cast, so damaging enemies with a flame spell will also inflict poison. The other regenerates mana over time...

[previewyoutube=bE2VKHwmP1w;full][/previewyoutube]

And that's not all! A new spell is available, which allows you to create portals just like in... well, Portal! Why would this ever be useful? I don't know. Maybe you want to escape a boss fight. Maybe you want to teleport the boss somewhere else? Well, you probably can, though it may cause unforseen consequences ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=fXUthf9lbOc;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyway, there's been a couple of improvements and bug fixes. Here's the list:

- Added option to return to title screen when Error UI shows up
- Improved the Arena a bit here and there, fixed enemies that were misbehaving and also fixed some translation issues
- Fixed an issue with the Bastard Sword typo, it was "Bastad Sword". Should be fixed
- Black Knights now ignore player if he's wearing Black Knight armor
- Fixed IKs on some weapons when sitting on bonfires, the player arm would be stretched
- Fixed automatic parries after taking damage and holding the block input
- Fixed particles not damaging player (introduced this bug on v1.3)
- Fixed push force pushing enemies out of the map when reputation was in high values

Apart from this, there's work being done on the future expansion of the game, which will take players to the mysterious island of Veilglade Peninsula. Here's a couple of screenshots and videos showcasing some progress on future content. Enjoy :)

notes.title: [v0.1.5] Huge update with end-game side-content and leaving Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/5d3148ddb06fb871b3048f595923748940937f64.png[/img]

Hello, everyone! 😊 It's been a productive few weeks finalizing game with additional content and bug fixes. The feedback I received during this initial phase has been very useful for polishing the game. Even though there are still many bugs to catch, I believe that the game is now at a stable phase where I'm confident it can leave early access.

With that said, this update introduces a ton of new weapons, spells and new enemy types. There's also new areas to explore and bosses to defeat. I hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44662009/8e66cb2a9409251a52d49e2d26d94756a5c2d95e.png[/img]

Here's the full list of new things:

[b]New Content and Features:[/b]
- Added a new mace weapon, the Morning Star;
- Added Foil, a new rapier-type weapon;
- Added Molok Blade, Celes Sword and Warchief Axe (previously was Goblin Axe) as boss weapons that can be acquired from Altaire in Snailcliff tower;
- Added a boss spell, the Moonbeam - trade the Midnight Omen token with Altaire for this devastating spell - its damage doubles when its nighttime;
- Added 3 new pyromancer spells: Spitfire, Slave to Fire and Burning Man;
- Added 1 new Magic Spell - the Magic Slash;
- Added 1 new Dark Spell - Raise Skeletons - raise your own army of skellies to fight for you!
- Added three new maps: Maerimond Cavern, Druid Forest, and Hell;
- Added new side-quest in Cecily Town regarding a skeleton that won't stay dead;
- Added new achievements to reflect the new content
- Added more recipes to the game - you can now craft weapon resins
- Added a variety of new enemy types
- Added new status effects: Fear and Confusion
- Added new consumable, the Duskcap, which restores some mana for magic users

[b]Improvements and bug fixes:[/b]
- Illusionary Walls now activate on touch.
- Fixed UI on quest menu, it was behaving weirdly when hovering over the quest buttons
- Resolved an issue when switching between bows and melee weapons
- Fixed bubbles not working in lock-on
- Fixed Bed of Thorns spell not colliding with enemies
- Improved Kyle The Guardian boss fight in Arun Village
- Fixed a critical bug with quicksave functionality
- Enhanced gold received UI

notes.title: Demo - Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been an exciting week with the steam next fest going on. I've had the chance to watch some people play the game and decided to update the demo based on the feedback I received.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Added tutorial hints outside Cacildes house. Many player are having difficulty learning the jump key, so I've addressed it with a tutorial.
- Fixed several bugs with the arena mini-game, like wolves spawning right at the center of the arena, or being stuck
- Added smooth animations to the main menu and the dialogue windows, it should improve the overall aspect of the UI
- Replaced many UI sounds

That's a short, but sweet one! 

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Following the demo release, there's been some bugs found and some things I noticed whilst watching many people play.

Here's the full changelog:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed a bug with Forest Wanderer Kyle - his dialogue was not triggering;
- Resolved the issue of duplicate dialogue with Dale, the one-armed forest wanderer;
- Fixed a bug where respawning at Bear Cavern map after dying during the boss battle - the fog wall was still active after reloading, preventing the player from reentering the area;
- Improved hitboxes for Cacilde's unarmed attacks
- Addressed the issue where UI elements overlapped, making the watch menu visible and interactable while sitting at a bonfire
- Fixed a bug where equipped weapons didn't display the "equipped" label when reloading
- Corrected distortion in the damage received label on the player
- Fixed a bug where slimes would dodge and not reappear on the surface
- Confetti trap didn't work on the bear, it's fixed now
- Fixed a bug where if we attacked and at the same time rested at a bonfire, it would make the player freeze in the attack animation
- Added control instructions near Cacilde's bed to show right away how to jump :')
- Moved the iron axe to be right outside Cacildes house, making it easy to find a weapon early on
- Improved the fog and visuals in many scenes


[b]New Additions:[/b]

- Added a tutorial section to the main menu, providing an overview of core game mechanics to enhance player understanding
- Included an indicator in the dialogue window to guide players on how to speed up and continue dialogue.


Hope this batch of bugfixes helps having a more enjoyable gameplaye experience. Thank you for playing!
